title: Semantic-adapter capability profile receipt propagation and callback inventory correction
mode: Local tooling self-tests plus exact locked-target and fresh standalone builds
scope: Bind per-side compile-time semantic-adapter capabilities into build receipts.
Require closed, typed capability profiles for controlled-driver receipt-pair admission while preserving older receipt schemas.
Reconcile the current standalone addBlockEnd callback with the immutable target interface without widening the target profile or lock.

changes.detail: Added a bounded --capability-profile JSON probe and compiled API/type checks for target versus standalone. Captures standalone addBlockEnd as a typed ENDBLK semantic record; target compilation does not declare that absent virtual callback.

Probes and validates exact capability JSON from target and standalone executables, includes it in each receipt config identity, tests malformed capability profiles, and upgrades the active callback profile to common170-standalone174-callbacks-v1. The synthetic builder adapter now implements the probe protocol.

Accepts additive config-identity shapes carrying capabilityProfile, validates side-specific exact Boolean maps, and requires symmetric profiles for controlled receipt pairs. Retains validation for historical common170-standalone173 receipts while preventing mixed-profile pairs.
Recorded current 170/174 callback inventory, receipt propagation, qualification holdbacks, and the still-red 3D consumer-probe runtime test.
